gaps.criterion: Failed gate creates a manager-visible integrity exception
gaps.gap: The manager-visible half is real and proven: evaluateActivationGate writes activation_state='blocked' locally BEFORE any SDK call, listIntegrityExceptions serves the queue off a partial index, and both are exercised by passing integration tests. The UNVERIFIED half is the upstream exception: raiseIntegrityException posts to sdk-incident and returns null when the gateway is unconfigured, and that call has never executed against a live gateway, so per MUST-56 it is unverified rather than working. Separately, tests/api_definitions/leads/integrity-exceptions-get.json has never been run by the API runner because the LeadFlow dev server on 3010 is down — the definition exists but has produced no result. Closing this needs one API-runner pass with the dev server up, plus one run with PROJEXCLOUD_* configured to confirm an incident is actually raised.
